there be 句型: 某处有某物用 there be 句型;后面的名词是单数或不可数用 is,复数用 are。
There is + 单数名词 / 不可数名词|There are + 复数名词|否定:There isn't / aren't (+ any)|疑问:Is / Are there...?|就近原则:be 与离它最近的名词保持一致
There is a park near my home.
There are many books on the desk.
Is there a hospital near here?

column4: a book 是单数,用 There is。
two cats 是复数,用 There are。

column4: milk 是不可数名词,按单数对待,用 Is。

# title: There ___ some children in the park.
There ___ a pen and two books on the table.
column4: 就近原则:be 靠最近的 a pen,用 is。

# title: There isn't ___ bread on the plate.
column4: 否定句中 some 变 any。
